trial_court: Judge, Family Court Kendrapara and Judge, Family Court Cuttack
case_name: Swarnalata Routray @ vs Sasanka Sekhar Pradhan — TRP (C) No. 92 of 2018
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed petition for transfer of C.P. No. 680 of 2014 from Judge, Family Court Kendrapara to Judge, Family Court Cuttack due to inconvenience in participating proceedings at Kendrapara.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the opposite party to participate in the proceeding and not cause harassment to the petitioner.
legal_principles.held: The opposite party should participate in the said proceeding itself.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another location if it is inconvenient for the petitioner to participate in the proceeding at the original location.
legal_principles.held: It appears that the opposite party should participate in the said proceeding itself.

outcome.final_order: The petition for transfer is allowed and C.P. No. 860 of 2014 be transferred from the file of Judge, Family Court, Kendrapara to the file of Judge, Family Court, Cuttack.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in a family court case
